MFCC extraction, cosine comparison, normalization and dynamic time warping
adapted from Rustpotter by Miguel Álvarez Díez and contributors.
https://github.com/GiviMAD/rustpotter
Revision: 46bbc73223afe5fc7b90f30455046432fc3c9432
License: Apache-2.0, included in LICENSE.

Lince retains only the Rust reference-comparison primitives. Neural model,
training, file-loader and audio-device dependencies are excluded. Source
documentation was omitted to follow this repository's source conventions.
Fiote owns bounded enrollment, validation, detection and native controls.
The FFT plan is cached, and the windowed DTW terminal-cost index is corrected.
Reference comparison uses two rolling DP rows to bound scratch allocation.
